question: Three point charges are placed at the vertices of a right-angled isosceles triangle ABC. A charge $+q$ is at the right-angle vertex A $(0, 0)$. Two other charges, $+Q$ and $-Q$, are placed at vertices B $(L, 0)$ and C $(0, L)$ respectively. What is the angle $α$ that the net electric field vector at the midpoint M of the hypotenuse BC makes with the positive x-axis?
